title: main.rs admin port bound twice at startup
description: In crates/transit/src/main.rs, the admin port is bound once in run_startup_checks and again in start_admin_server. The first bind is a connectivity check; the listener is dropped and re-created. On a heavily loaded system the port could be taken by another process in the window between the two binds. The startup check should pass the bound listener to start_admin_server instead of re-binding.
